Case Name: Dry-run a valid PSOP with generated stub agents
Precondition:
1. registry-center is reachable at http://127.0.0.1:5000 and a registry access token is available (REGISTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN)
2. The orchestration-center backend is running on 127.0.0.1:5001 with persistence_mode=file and agent_registry_url=http://127.0.0.1:5000 set in etc/conf/server.conf
3. An orchestration-center admin account exists and a Bearer session token from POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/auth/login is available
4. Two domain AgentCards are registered that declare the Task-T extension and the exact skills the PSOP references; their A2A endpoints are not started (the dry-run uses generated stubs only)
5. A valid two-step linear PSOP fixture is prepared (step_1 -> step_2 -> endNode) with one subtask per step and no step text mentioning negotiation
Steps:
1. Create the workflow with POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/workflows and read data.workflow_id (see result 1)
2. Start the dry-run with POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/{workflow_id}/run body {"scenario":"success","lang":"en"} (see result 2)
3. Poll GET /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/verifications/{verification_id} until data.status is completed (see result 3)
4. Read GET /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/verifications/{verification_id}/events and then DELETE the verification (see result 4)
5. Cleanup: DELETE the workflow and deregister the two test AgentCards (see result 5)
Expected Result:
1. POST returns 201 with data.workflow_id equal to the PSOP id
2. POST returns 202 with data.status=queued and a non-empty data.verification_id
3. GET returns 200 with data.status=completed; data.report.verdict=pass; data.report.mode=sandbox; data.report.verification_scope=structure_and_stub_execution; data.report.route_policy=always_allow_stub; every data.report.static_checks[] entry has status=pass and the ids structure.cycle, structure.reachability, agents.missing and agents.task_t_extension are present; data.report.execution_path is ["step_1", "step_2"]; data.report.stub_interactions has 2 entries, each with task_state=TASK_STATE_COMPLETED and template_id=generated-card-default; data.report.risks is empty and data.report.error is null
4. The events endpoint returns a non-empty list that contains step_start, agent_request, agent_response and complete events; DELETE returns 200 with data.deleted equal to the verification id
5. The workflow GET returns 404 and both AgentCard GETs return 200 with an empty agentCards list (detail route returns an empty list for a missing card)

Case Name: Dry-run verifies context passed to the merge step
Precondition:
1. registry-center is reachable at http://127.0.0.1:5000 and a registry access token is available (REGISTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN)
2. The orchestration-center backend is running on 127.0.0.1:5001 with persistence_mode=file and agent_registry_url=http://127.0.0.1:5000 set in etc/conf/server.conf
3. An orchestration-center admin account exists and a Bearer session token from POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/auth/login is available
4. One domain AgentCard is registered that declares Task-T and the skill used by both parallel steps
5. A parallel PSOP fixture is prepared: diagnose_city1 and diagnose_city2 both jump to merge, and merge is a SelfLoop step with context_from=["diagnose_city1","diagnose_city2"]
Steps:
1. Create the parallel PSOP with POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/workflows (see result 1)
2. Start the dry-run with POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/{workflow_id}/run body {"scenario":"success","lang":"en"} (see result 2)
3. Poll GET /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/verifications/{verification_id} until completed (see result 3)
4. Cleanup: DELETE the verification, DELETE the workflow and DELETE the AgentCard (see result 4)
Expected Result:
1. POST returns 201 with data.workflow_id equal to the PSOP id
2. POST returns 202 with data.status=queued
3. data.report.verdict=pass; data.report.execution_path has 3 entries whose first two are diagnose_city1 and diagnose_city2 in either order and whose last is merge; data.report.context_trace contains a merge entry whose upstream_steps is exactly {diagnose_city1, diagnose_city2} and upstream_result_count=2; data.report.stub_interactions has 2 entries (the SelfLoop merge step runs locally and adds no stub interaction)
4. DELETE returns 200, the verification re-query returns 404 and the workflow re-query returns 404

Case Name: Apply a step-scoped stub template to the dry-run
Precondition:
1. registry-center is reachable at http://127.0.0.1:5000 and a registry access token is available (REGISTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN)
2. The orchestration-center backend is running on 127.0.0.1:5001 with persistence_mode=file and agent_registry_url=http://127.0.0.1:5000 set in etc/conf/server.conf
3. An orchestration-center admin account exists and a Bearer session token from POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/auth/login is available
4. Domain AgentCards for agent-a (step_1) and agent-b (step_2) are registered with Task-T and matching skills
5. Two stub templates are prepared: T1 targets step_1 with subtask_index 0 and response_text "stub {{step_name}}/{{skill}}"; T2 targets agent agent-b with response_text "agent-b default"
Steps:
1. Save both templates with PUT /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/templates/{workflow_id} (see result 1)
2. Read them back with GET /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/templates/{workflow_id} (see result 2)
3. Start the dry-run with POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/{workflow_id}/run, passing T1 and T2 in the body templates array with scenario success and lang en (see result 3)
4. Poll GET /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/verifications/{verification_id} until completed (see result 4)
5. Cleanup: DELETE the verification, reset the saved templates with PUT body [], DELETE the workflow and deregister both AgentCards (see result 5)
Expected Result:
1. PUT returns 200 with data.template_count=2
2. GET returns 200 with 2 entries whose template_id, workflow_id, step, agent and response_text equal the saved values
3. POST returns 202 with data.status=queued
4. data.report.verdict=pass; the step_1 interaction has template_id equal to T1 and response_text "stub step_1/skill-a" (only whitelisted variables are rendered); the step_2 interaction has template_id equal to T2 and response_text "agent-b default" (the agent-scoped template wins because T1 does not match step_2)
5. The verification DELETE returns 200, the template PUT returns data.template_count=0, the workflow re-query returns 404 and both AgentCard re-queries return 200 with an empty agentCards list (detail route returns an empty list for a missing card)

Case Name: Reject invalid stub template payloads with 400
Precondition:
1. registry-center is reachable at http://127.0.0.1:5000 and a registry access token is available (REGISTRY_ACCESS_TOKEN)
2. The orchestration-center backend is running on 127.0.0.1:5001 with persistence_mode=file and agent_registry_url=http://127.0.0.1:5000 set in etc/conf/server.conf
3. An orchestration-center admin account exists and a Bearer session token from POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/auth/login is available
4. One domain AgentCard is registered with Task-T and the skill the PSOP references
5. A valid one-step PSOP workflow exists and its workflow_id is recorded
Steps:
1. PUT /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/templates/{workflow_id} with body [{"response_text":"ok","unknown_field":1}] (see result 1)
2. PUT the same endpoint with body [{"response_text":"ok","delay_ms":10001}] (see result 2)
3. PUT the same endpoint with 201 generated template entries (see result 3)
4. PUT the same endpoint with 200 generated template entries (see result 4)
5. Cleanup: reset the templates with PUT body [], DELETE the workflow and deregister the AgentCard (see result 5)
Expected Result:
1. Returns 400 because StubTemplate forbids extra fields and no template is stored
2. Returns 400 because delay_ms must be between 0 and 10000
3. Returns 400 because at most 200 templates are accepted
4. Returns 200 with data.template_count=200, and a follow-up GET returns exactly 200 entries
5. The reset PUT returns data.template_count=0, the workflow re-query returns 404 and the AgentCard re-query returns 200 with an empty agentCards list (detail route returns an empty list for a missing card)

Steps:
1. Start the dry-run with POST /rest/v1/orchestrate/sandbox/draft-workflow-001/run, passing the snapshot in body psop together with scenario success and lang en (see result 1)
